decisions.reason: The margin analysis still has its own page in 2024, which suggests results that meet the firm's aspirations, and it extends the established market-data platform at low marginal cost, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The calculator fell from its own page to a mere mention, a sign of weaker priority, but it runs on the maintained tariff database and the firm's slack lets it carry the product while sibling products B, D and F are consolidated.

The area definition tool was also downgraded to a mention, but it supports the regional and location-based offers on the central platform, so dropping it would free few resources and it is likely kept as an integrated component.
